title.original: CuBridge: An LLM-Based Framework for Understanding and Reconstructing High-Performance Attention Kernels
title.zh: CuBridge：理解并重建高性能注意力内核的 LLM 框架
title.en: CuBridge: An LLM-Based Framework for Understanding and Reconstructing High-Performance Attention Kernels

inclusion_reason.zh: CuBridge 的可执行 IR、验证器和参考引导 lowering 构成从专家 CUDA 到新注意力变体的可复用 kernel 迁移工具链。
inclusion_reason.en: CuBridge's executable IR, verifier, and reference-guided lowering form a reusable toolchain for transferring expert CUDA kernels to new attention variants.

abstract.zh: CuBridge 通过 lift-transfer-lower 流程改造专家编写的注意力 CUDA kernel：先提升为可执行 IR，再按 PyTorch 目标规范迁移，最后参考原实现还原优化 CUDA。
abstract.en: CuBridge adapts expert attention CUDA kernels through a lift-transfer-lower workflow: it raises them into executable IR, transfers to a PyTorch target specification, then reconstructs optimized CUDA using the reference.

problem.zh: 专家 kernel 性能高却难适配新注意力变体，通用编译器牺牲性能，直接让 LLM 生成复杂 CUDA 又经常不正确或明显变慢。
problem.en: Expert kernels are fast but hard to adapt, general compilers trade performance for flexibility, and direct LLM generation of complex CUDA is often incorrect or slow.

approach.zh: 框架从可信 CUDA 提取显式执行编排并抽象语法细节，LLM 在 IR 层生成目标程序，经验证后再以参考引导的 lowering 恢复低层优化。
approach.en: The framework lifts trusted CUDA into an IR that exposes orchestration while hiding syntax, lets the LLM produce a target IR program, verifies it, and lowers with reference-guided low-level optimization.

system_design.zh: 输入包括专家 kernel 与用户 PyTorch 规范；lifter 生成可执行 IR，transfer 模块提出并测试变体，lowerer 结合参考模式输出 CUDA，验证器检查正确性和性能。
system_design.en: Inputs are an expert kernel and user PyTorch specification; a lifter builds executable IR, transfer proposes and tests variants, lowering emits CUDA with reference patterns, and validation checks correctness and performance.

key_results.zh: 在多种注意力变体和 GPU 上，CuBridge 稳定生成正确 kernel，并优于通用框架、编译器方法和既有 LLM kernel 生成方案。
key_results.en: Across attention variants and GPUs, CuBridge consistently produces correct kernels and outperforms general frameworks, compiler approaches, and prior LLM-based kernel generation.

limitations.zh: 方法需要相近的专家参考 kernel，IR 未覆盖的结构难以迁移；测试集验证仍可能漏掉边界错误，新 GPU 也需扩展 lowering 知识。
limitations.en: The method requires a related expert reference, cannot transfer structures outside IR coverage, can miss edge cases not exercised by tests, and needs new lowering knowledge for new GPUs.

models: attention kernels defined by PyTorch specifications

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件与基线均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未给出可安全转录的结果数字，表格明细与部署配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, and baselines come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; the abstract provides no result number safe to transcribe, and table details plus deployment configuration still require full-text audit.
